text: てもちが　いっぱいの　ようじゃな…　てもちを　せいり　してから　また　きなさい

structure.jp: てもちが　いっぱいの　ようじゃな…
structure.en: your party seems to be full...

structure.jp: てもちを　せいり　してから

patterns.name: 〜てから
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus から means 'after doing' that. せいり　してから = 'after you sort it out'.

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.span: いっぱいの　ようじゃ
patterns.explanation: ようだ says 'it looks like', judging from what the speaker sees; じゃ is the old-man form of だ. いっぱいの　ようじゃ = 'it seems to be full'.

patterns.name: 〜なさい
patterns.explanation: なさい on a verb is a gentle order, the kind an older person gives a younger one. きなさい = 'come'.
